label: Teltonika OTD144
description: Outdoor Wi-Fi 4G Cat 4 router: 2x 100 Mbps Ethernet, 802.3af/at PoE in on the left port and 15 W of 802.3af Mode B PoE out on the right one.

poe.note: 15 W on the single outlet, same chassis as the OTD140. Datasheet v1.22 (2026-09-24): "PoE ports 1 x PoE Out", "PoE standards 802.3af Alternative B", "PoE Max Power per Port (at PSE) 15 W Max (power supply unit dependent)", beside "PoE ports 1 x PoE In", "PoE standards 802.3af/at" and "Power consumption Idle: < 2.5 W / Max: < 6 W / PoE Max < 21 W". Flyer v1.1 (2025) prints the outlet as "PoE Out: 802.3af/at (42.5 - 57 VDC, max 15 W - power supply unit dependent)": the wattage agrees, the /at does not, and the newer datasheet plus the wiki's "802.3af standard for the PSE port" are what the class follows. 6 W of router plus 15 W of outlet is the 21 W inlet ceiling.

notes:
Read 2026-11-21. The previous sourceUrl (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/3/3785/1/OTD144_Datasheet_v1.pdf) answers 200 with 13,897 bytes of text/html - a landing page, not a datasheet - so it is replaced. PORT CENSUS - datasheet v1.22, 2026-09-24, https://solwise.co.uk/downloads/files/Datasheet_OTD144_06-10-2026.pdf (application/pdf, text layer): "2 x RJ45 ports, 10/100 Mbps", "1 x PoE In" / "802.3af/at", "1 x PoE Out" / "802.3af Alternative B" / "15 W Max (power supply unit dependent)", "Power consumption Idle: < 2.5 W / Max: < 6 W / PoE Max < 21 W". https://wiki.teltonika-networks.com/view/OTD144_Interfaces (200) gives "2 x RJ45 ethernet ports", "2 x SIM slot", "2.4 GHz radio", "4G LTE Cat 4". https://wiki.teltonika-networks.com/view/OTD144_Powering_Options (200, 63,454 B): "802.3af/at for the PD (Powered Device) port and 802.3af standard for the PSE (Power Source Equipment) port", "Working voltage levels: 42.5-57.0 V", Mode B pinout DC+ on 4/5, DC- on 7/8.

WHAT WAS WRONG - the same defect as its non-Wi-Fi sibling: eth1 declared poeIn 12.95 (the 802.3af class ceiling) where the vendor rates the inlet 802.3af/at and 21 W, and eth2 carried poeOut true with poeOutClass "PoE+" - 802.3at, which no current Teltonika document claims for the outlet. poeDraw() billed the outlet 1 W.

WHAT IT IS NOW - eth1 sinks 21 W, eth2 sources 15 W classed 802.3af, and the poe block states the 15 W so the budget is a document, not a name-parse.

NOT MODELLED - the "power supply unit dependent" condition (a 15.4 W 802.3af upstream cannot make 15 W appear at eth2), the idle draw, and the second SIM slot. The Wi-Fi rate (300M) predates this read; no Teltonika text layer prints per-band Wi-Fi 4 rates, so it is left as it was rather than re-guessed.
